months.note: 해에 따라 찾아오는 수가 크게 다르고 여름에도 드물게 보이며, 번식지에서는 3~4월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라 전역에서 흔히 겨울을 나는 겨울새로, 주로 소나무 숲 가장자리에 산다. 번식기가 아닐 때는 무리 지어 지내며, 땅에는 잘 내려앉지 않고 대부분 나무 위에서 생활한다. 소나무과 씨앗을 즐겨 먹고 장미과·국화과 씨앗과 나무눈, 나비 애벌레·딱정벌레·파리 무리 같은 곤충도 먹는다. 아무르·우수리·일본·중국 북부·사할린·쿠릴 열도 등지에서 번식하는데, 땅에서 5m 넘는 큰키나무 가지에 둥지를 틀고 알을 3~5개, 흔히 4개 낳는다.

sexes.male: 온몸이 어두운 붉은색(벽돌빛)이고 날개와 꼬리는 검은 갈색이며 날개띠가 없다.
sexes.female: 붉은색 대신 올리브빛 도는 황록색이고, 허리가 가장 노랗다.

young: 어린새는 붉은빛이나 노란빛 없이 회갈색 바탕에 온몸에 짙은 갈색 세로줄무늬가 많고, 큰날개덮깃 끝이 담황색이라 희미한 날개띠처럼 보인다. 첫 겨울 수컷은 노란색·주황색·붉은색이 얼룩덜룩 섞인 깃이 많다.

similar.how: 흰죽지솔잣새는 검은 날개에 굵은 흰 날개띠가 두 줄 있고 셋째날개깃 끝도 희어, 날개띠가 없는 솔잣새와 쉽게 가려진다.

art.subject: Red Crossbill (Loxia curvirostra), adult male in winter: head, body and rump dull brick-red, darkest on the crown and back; nasal bristles brown; lores, eye-stripe and upper ear coverts pale brownish, duller than the red crown; wings plain dark brown without wing bars, the lesser coverts tinged reddish-brown; tail dark brown, notched, with narrow yellowish edges; centre of the belly and undertail coverts whitish, the undertail coverts with dark brown shaft marks; heavy dark brown bill with crossed tips, the sides of the lower mandible paler; brown iris; dark brown legs.
art.pose: clinging to a pine branch, taking seeds from a cone
art.scene: Korean winter pine-forest edge; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view clinging to a pine cone: dull red head, body and rump, plain dark brown wings with reddish-brown lesser coverts, notched dark tail, whitish belly centre and vent, crossed bill tips clearly visible
adult male, head close-up in profile: dark red crown, pale brownish eye-stripe and upper ear coverts, heavy dark brown bill with crossed tips and paler sides to the lower mandible
adult female, side view perched: greyish olive-green with a brighter yellow-green rump, plain dark wings, the same crossed bill
art.build: Stocky, big-headed finch, a little larger than a sparrow, with a thick neck and a short, notched tail. Bill heavy and deep at the base, slightly shorter than the head; the upper mandible tip curves down and the lower mandible tip curves up, so the two tips cross over each other sideways. Legs short, strong, dark brown. Clambers parrot-like over pine branches and cones, often hanging upside down. Wings fairly long and pointed; flight bounding.
avoid: Do not draw a normal finch bill with closed, meeting tips; the mandible tips must visibly cross.
Do not paint white wing bars — that is Two-barred Crossbill (Loxia leucoptera).
Do not paint the male bright crimson like a rosefinch; it is a duller brick- to orange-red.
Do not paint a long tail; the tail is short and notched.
